objective: The Hooks Store, job 8: catalog hardening, so that no request leaves the builder a guess and no sentence earns a high audit finding. Three launches blocked after payment and the audit panels found design flaws in our sentences; SPEC.md section 4.16 (version 1.31, 30 numbered rules) is the complete list and binds this job: implement every rule of 4.16 in src/blocks/catalog.json, src/lib/compose.ts and the Builder. The headline items: (1) type B and C requests open with a deployer whose constructor mines the CREATE2 salt itself (no salt argument, no deploy function afterwards), forwards the PoolManager, $owner and the recipient unchanged, and exposes hook(); the site shows 'hook not deployed yet' when hook() is zero; B and C bodies carry the references uniswap-v4-hooks and uniswap-v4-security; the wording IMD's free check accepted is in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec/main/evidence/check-B-deployer.request.json, amended as 4.16 item 1 says. (2) type A requests say beforeInitialize accepts only the IMD launch factory passed as $factory, with constructor arguments PoolManager address, $owner and $factory (item 2). (3) B and C requests restrict initialization to pools whose currency0 is native ETH, key every pool-dependent view and limit by PoolId, and define the token (item 3). (4) every fee side, settlement, threshold and unit follows the pair currency, IMD pairs add the no-conversion and currency-order sentences, and with no fee block the composer writes 'Hook fee rate: 0%.' (items 4 and 9). (5) every request without Yield says the hook uses no outside pool, token, price feed or service; the body always carries owner; type A names the factory, B and C never do (items 5 to 7). (6) fees are computed on the amount traded and a partly filled swap that specified the pair-currency amount reverts; Whale fee, Fee that fades, Volatility fee, Split the fee and Share fees with LPs are tied to one rate and one destination as item 10 says; 'burn' leaves the fee blocks; 'my wallet' is the paying wallet's address and 'treasury' is IMD's 0x3f252e859a277a86A3967c11D4E054B2f07a1F22 (items 8, 10). (7) the Buyback jar buys only inside buyback() with a 3% price limit and keeps the standard token's bought tokens forever, the own token gains burn(uint256), the existing token burns only if it can (item 11); Share fees with LPs and Prize pot as items 12 and 13. (8) the Anti-sandwich sentence, windows starting at the first swap, wallets as tx.origin with the stated limit, seconds instead of blocks, Max swap size on token amounts only, liquidity rules keyed per position, Sunset and Donation rules as items 14 to 21. (9) excludes become lists as item 22 says; Batch auctions is dimmed 'not in this version'; Dynamic LP fee needs the dynamic-fee flag and 6.4 initializes with it; Yield stays dimmed (items 23 to 25). (10) words mode and Custom rule carry the warning and checklist, compose no hidden blocks, never deny owner functions the description grants, and a numbered rule wins; the six-block notice; mulDiv and the own-token supply cap (items 26 to 28). Carry-overs: in the Describe it mode the hidden block stack was composed into the request (contradictory), and the composer wrote 'No owner functions' against a description granting them; both are covered by item 26. Tests: composer tests for every block under every type and pairing assert the sentences of 4.16 (no ETH in an IMD-paired request outside the opt-out sentence, the deployer and factory sentences, the definition line, the references, 'Hook fee rate: 0%' when no fee block, the excludes lists); the consistency check of 6.7 fails on each forbidden combination; Playwright at 320, 390 and 1440 for the Builder in both modes. Refresh SPEC.md from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec/main/SPEC.md (now 1.31). Everything else from job 7 stays as delivered. Deliver source, dist/ and test results under tests/results/job8. The second step is an adversarial review by a different seat, read-only, of the composed requests for every block under every type and pairing against SPEC 4.16, the consistency check, the fixed-facts comparison and the deployer and factory sentences: it reports concrete reproductions of any sentence a builder would have to guess, any sentence that would earn a high audit finding, or any check that lets one through, and the owner carries confirmed findings into the next job.
